sections.introduction:
Naadivranhar Taila is a classical Ayurvedic medicated oil formulated with penetrating, cleansing, and tissue-purifying substances processed in a sesame oil base. The preparation is traditionally indicated for external application in chronic sinus wounds and non-healing ulcerative tracts characterized by discharge, tissue degeneration, and persistent inflammation. The formulation integrates Tikshna (penetrative), Shodhana (cleansing), and Ropana (healing) supportive dravyas to assist in purification of affected tissue and promotion of structural repair.

sections.composition:
I. Taila Dravya (Base Oil) 

 Tila Taila (Sesamum indicum – Sesame Oil) 

 II. Kalka Dravyas (Processed Ingredients) 

 Bhallataka (Semecarpus anacardium – Marking Nut) 
 Kapikacchu Beeja (Mucuna pruriens – Cowhage Seed) 
 Khorasani Yavani (Hyoscyamus niger – Henbane Seed) 
 Murdasanga (Lead Oxide – traditionally used mineral preparation) 
 Nila Tuttha (Copper Sulphate – purified mineral preparation) 

 Method Of Preparation 
 Measured Tila Taila (Sesamum indicum) is heated in a suitable vessel over mild fire. When the oil begins to boil, Bhallataka (Semecarpus anacardium) is introduced and properly processed. Finely powdered Kapikacchu Beeja (Mucuna pruriens) and Khorasani Yavani (Hyoscyamus niger) are then added and stirred uniformly. The vessel is removed from heat and triturated with Murdasanga and Nila Tuttha until uniform dispersion is achieved. The preparation is filtered when required and stored in a clean airtight glass container. 
 Method Of Use 

 External application only. 
 The medicated oil is applied locally over the affected area or used to soak sterile dressing material for placement over sinus wounds as directed by a qualified Ayurvedic practitioner.

The integration of Bhallataka (Semecarpus anacardium), Kapikacchu Beeja (Mucuna pruriens), Khorasani Yavani (Hyoscyamus niger), and classical mineral preparations in Tila Taila (Sesamum indicum) produces a preparation intended to support tissue cleansing and structural restoration. By assisting removal of unhealthy tissue components and promoting localized repair, this classical formulation serves as a supportive therapeutic measure in persistent discharging wounds. When applied appropriately under professional supervision, the oil contributes to stabilization of tissue integrity and enhancement of natural healing processes in chronic sinus conditions.

The oil is used externally through local application or medicated dressing as a supportive measure in chronic discharging wounds.

The vessel is removed from heat and triturated with Murdasanga and Nila Tuttha until uniform dispersion is achieved.
